text:
asha: Quick update 1 Cinder wants Dedicated pool switched over next Tue. They9re asking for autoscale on and pool primed by EOD Mon. Can we lock in quota + a load rehearsal?

luis: Do we have their traffic shape? I pulled the onboarding doc: steady 40rps, avg 300 tokens, with weekly marketing spikes to ~120rps (109min bursts).

asha: Correct. SLA ask: p95 tail <150ms. Renewal in 10mo so first 90d experience matters.

priya: Autoscale config proposal: target util 65% (soft burst to 85% for <=10m). Enable prefix KV caching for their canned prompts.

luis: 65% makes sense. Also recommend reserving warmup tokens to avoid cold p99s: propose 10M warmup tokens across first 2h post-cutover.

tom: Confirmed with Cinder procurement 1 they9re okay with a one-off warmup credit, legal cleared.

priya: Load rehearsal plan (two-phase + chaos):
1) preflight: 5m @15rps to seed KV caches.
2) smoke: 30m @20rps to validate routing & model-fallback behavior.
3) soak: ramp 40 -> 120rps over 90m, hold 15m at peak.
4) chaos: during soak, induce a model-variant fail for 2m to validate seamless fallback.
Metrics: GPU util, queue depth, KV hit%, token/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies, fallback rate.

luis: I9ll run the soak from our k6 harness. Snippet: 

```
// k6 sketch
stages: [ {duration: '5m', target: 15}, {duration: '30m', target: 20}, {duration: '10m', target: 40}, {duration: '80m', target: 120}, {duration: '15m', target: 120}, {duration: '5m', target: 0} ]
vus: 250
payload: {avg_tokens:300}
chaos: at 60m into soak -> simulate variant down
```

asha: Add the warmup period before smoke + ensure the warmup tokens are throttled so billing credit applies.

priya: Add alerting: fallback_rate >0.5% -> page SRE; fallback_rate >1% -> immediate rollback. Also watch router 5xxs and per-instance queue length.

luis: Will instrument k6 to emit CSV + push grafana snapshots. I9ll post results here within 1h after run.

deploy-bot: loadtest-scheduler: rehearsal job scheduled -> https://ci.internal/loadtests/1713344600-cinder-rehearsal (Mon 23:00 UTC) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

asha: Owners: luis (execute load + upload logs), priya (SRE checks + fallback verification), tom (customer comms + golden prompts + billing). I9ll own final quota priming sign-off and postmortem.

tom: I9ll ping Cinder with the window and ask them to provide 3 golden prompts for QoE checks during soak. Also confirm on-call contact.

luis: One more thing: include a short smoke with model pin mismatch to ensure routing fallback tree works (rare in prod).

priya: Noted. I9ll add a dashboard panel for variant-fallback latency and KV hit delta. If fallback latency >200ms for >0.1% requests, capture traces.

asha: Action items checklist:
- luis: run k6 rehearsal + attach CSV + grafana links (owner)
- priya: validate fallback behavior + set alerts (owner)
- tom: confirm warmup credit, collect golden prompts, share on-call (owner)
- asha: review run results and sign-off quota priming (owner)

asha: Anything missing? If not, proceed with smoke+soak rehearsal Mon 23:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
